turns.question: Our project concerns implementing and testing a punctuated stateful processor. For the planned deployment, set application.id to elm-process-17. Which value should we use, and which ordering of processing and offset saving gives at-least-once consumption?

turns.answer: The project application.id is elm-process-17. Read, process, then save the position gives at-least-once consumption.
key_facts: The project application.id is elm-process-17.
Read, process, then save the position gives at-least-once consumption.

evidence.quote: set application.id to elm-process-17
